related.title: Natrium 鈉冷快堆與熔鹽儲熱示範廠
related.titleEn: Natrium Sodium Fast Reactor with Molten-Salt Storage
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Natrium 鈉冷快堆與熔鹽儲熱示範廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Natrium Sodium Fast Reactor with Molten-Salt Storage must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的運轉中快中子反應爐：池式鈉冷、三迴路、模組化蒸汽產生器與鈉池熱慣性；Natrium 鈉冷快堆與熔鹽儲熱示範廠則以鈉冷快堆搭配熔鹽儲熱：常壓鈉池、核島與能源島分離、儲熱量與鹽量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest operating fast reactor: a sodium pool, three circuits, modular steam generators and thermal inertia of the pool; Natrium Sodium Fast Reactor with Molten-Salt Storage centres on A sodium fast reactor with molten-salt storage: an unpressurised sodium pool, separate nuclear and energy islands, storage energy and salt inventory, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「三迴路與分段的蒸汽產生器」的模型移到Natrium 鈉冷快堆與熔鹽儲熱示範廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Three circuits and sectioned steam generators" to Natrium Sodium Fast Reactor with Molten-Salt Storage, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Natrium 鈉冷快堆與熔鹽儲熱示範廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Natrium Sodium Fast Reactor with Molten-Salt Storage must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 別洛雅爾斯克 BN-800 鈉冷快堆機組
history.titleEn: Beloyarsk BN-800 Sodium-Cooled Fast Reactor Unit
history.text: 1980 年同廠的 BN-600 開始運轉；2006 年BN-800 工程全面復工；2014 年首次臨界；2015 年首次併網；2016 年機組商轉。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1980: The BN-600 at the same station began operation. 2006: Full construction of the BN-800 resumed. 2014: First criticality. 2015: First grid connection. 2016: The unit entered commercial operation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
